policy: Rules are contextual heuristics unless they cite an applicable normative criterion. Rule force is not severity. A heuristic is not a confirmed defect until actual UI evidence is inspected.

forceDefinitions.required: Must be satisfied within scope unless documented exception or higher-priority constraint applies.
forceDefinitions.recommended: Preferred default; deviations need product-specific rationale.
forceDefinitions.antiPattern: Risk pattern to inspect; its presence is not proof of a defect.

severityDefinitions.P0: Critical: blocks core task or creates severe accessibility/integrity risk.
severityDefinitions.P1: High: materially harms a common task or broad accessibility.
severityDefinitions.P2: Moderate: causes friction, inconsistency or recoverable confusion.
severityDefinitions.P3: Low: polish opportunity with limited impact.

rules.statement: Define the user task before choosing visual patterns.
rules.trigger: Brief has style adjectives but no primary user job.
rules.rationale: Aesthetic-first selection can undermine usefulness.
rules.recommendedAction: Record primary job, audience, requested surface and success outcome.
rules.exceptions: A visual showcase may have exploration as its primary job.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Choose an experience mode per surface, not per product.
rules.trigger: The same mode is applied to every route.
rules.rationale: A marketing page and workspace have different success conditions.
rules.recommendedAction: Choose Persuade, Operate, Read or Experience per surface.
rules.exceptions: One surface may combine modes by region.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Give each screen a clear primary hierarchy.
rules.trigger: Several elements compete with equivalent visual weight.
rules.rationale: Users cannot identify the first useful action.
rules.recommendedAction: Choose one primary message or task and subordinate supporting content.
rules.exceptions: Editorial compositions may intentionally distribute attention.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Define type roles and a readable scale.
rules.trigger: Headings, body and labels have no consistent role.
rules.rationale: Scanning and reading become tiring.
rules.recommendedAction: Use display, heading, body, label, caption and code roles as needed.
rules.exceptions: A single family can form a complete system.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Constrain long-form line length and preserve comfortable line-height.
rules.trigger: Paragraphs span a wide viewport or body lines are dense.
rules.rationale: Reading requires excessive horizontal eye movement.
rules.recommendedAction: Set measure and line-height for font and language.
rules.exceptions: Tables and code may need wider measures.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Use a coherent spacing scale with relational exceptions.
rules.trigger: Spacing appears arbitrary or every relationship has the same gap.
rules.rationale: Grouping and hierarchy weaken.
rules.recommendedAction: Define a base scale and choose gaps by semantic relationship.
rules.exceptions: Optical alignment or data density can justify exceptions.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Choose composition from content and task; do not default to split hero plus three cards.
rules.trigger: Same template structure appears across unrelated surfaces.
rules.rationale: The interface feels generic rather than product-specific.
rules.recommendedAction: Compare eligible alternatives when structure matters.
rules.exceptions: Split layout is valid when it is the clearest answer.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Use the hero to communicate a specific promise and evidence.
rules.trigger: Hero contains abstract claims or unrelated decoration.
rules.rationale: First viewport does not explain the offer.
rules.recommendedAction: Use concrete message, recognizable product visual and clear action.
rules.exceptions: Typographic hero may fit a deliberate brand.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Keep the primary operation and context visible.
rules.trigger: User searches unrelated cards/views to continue a common task.
rules.rationale: Orientation and throughput suffer.
rules.recommendedAction: Group controls by workflow and preserve selected context.
rules.exceptions: Focused single-purpose tool may need minimal nav.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Preserve task-critical content and controls at narrow viewports.
rules.trigger: Overflow or hidden primary actions appear.
rules.rationale: Small-screen users cannot complete tasks.
rules.recommendedAction: Reflow and simplify secondary chrome while retaining context.
rules.exceptions: Specialized canvases may use labelled horizontal regions.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Map colors to semantic roles and verify actual combinations.
rules.trigger: Raw colors are applied without role or state mapping.
rules.rationale: Themes and states become inconsistent.
rules.recommendedAction: Define canvas, surfaces, text, borders, actions, focus and statuses.
rules.exceptions: A simple illustration may need fewer roles.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Check contrast on actual composited colors.
rules.trigger: Text overlays imagery, transparency or gradients without measurement.
rules.rationale: HEX values alone do not represent rendered contrast.
rules.recommendedAction: Measure final colors at real text sizes and states.
rules.exceptions: Decorative elements have applicable criteria.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Specify loading, empty, error, disabled, success and focus states.
rules.trigger: Only ideal populated state is designed.
rules.rationale: Users cannot understand system response or recover.
rules.recommendedAction: Document state model for critical controls.
rules.exceptions: Static read-only content needs fewer states.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Preserve user input and context during recoverable errors.
rules.trigger: Validation clears fields or progress.
rules.rationale: Users repeat work and lose confidence.
rules.recommendedAction: Keep safe values and explain recovery.
rules.exceptions: Sensitive data may need clearing for security.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Motion must communicate feedback, state, continuity or intentional storytelling.
rules.trigger: Animation exists only to decorate.
rules.rationale: Motion competes with content and slows interaction.
rules.recommendedAction: Remove motion without user or brand purpose.
rules.exceptions: Experience surfaces may use expressive motion.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Provide a reduced-motion path for non-essential motion.
rules.trigger: Information or interaction depends on animation.
rules.rationale: Users may lose access or experience discomfort.
rules.recommendedAction: Respect reduced-motion preference and preserve meaningful state.
rules.exceptions: Essential spatial motion needs suitable alternative.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Use cards only for meaningful independent units.
rules.trigger: Every section becomes an identical grid.
rules.rationale: Visual chrome adds noise.
rules.recommendedAction: Consider lists, tables, steps or editorial blocks.
rules.exceptions: Cards suit comparable independent items.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Prefer native semantic controls before custom interactive elements.
rules.trigger: Clickable divs replace buttons/links/inputs without reason.
rules.rationale: Keyboard and assistive technology support degrade.
rules.recommendedAction: Use native HTML or document custom behavior.
rules.exceptions: Canvas tools may need custom pointer/keyboard handling.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Give controls persistent accessible labels and clear validation.
rules.trigger: Placeholder is the only label.
rules.rationale: Users lose context; accessible naming may be unclear.
rules.recommendedAction: Use labels, descriptions, required cues and field errors.
rules.exceptions: Compact search can use accessible name and context.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Navigation should reflect information architecture and user frequency.
rules.trigger: Navigation follows fashion or has too many destinations.
rules.rationale: Users cannot predict where tasks live.
rules.recommendedAction: Group by task and frequency; expose current location.
rules.exceptions: Portfolio index may be novel if discoverable.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Label metrics with units, period, scope and provenance.
rules.trigger: Charts show numbers without definitions or time window.
rules.rationale: Users misinterpret measurements.
rules.recommendedAction: Add units, range, source and freshness.
rules.exceptions: Illustrative charts must be labelled.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Do not fabricate live metrics, status or availability.
rules.trigger: Demo values appear live without identification.
rules.rationale: Users mistake mock data for operational truth.
rules.recommendedAction: Use real data or conspicuously labelled fixtures.
rules.exceptions: Prototypes may use explicit mock data.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Do not invent factual claims, testimonials, customer logos or certifications.
rules.trigger: Trust content has no source.
rules.rationale: Interface misleads and may create legal risk.
rules.recommendedAction: Use supplied verified content or labelled placeholders.
rules.exceptions: Fictional concepts must be clearly fictional.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Choose imagery that demonstrates product or story.
rules.trigger: Generic stock substitutes for product evidence.
rules.rationale: Images weaken comprehension and distinctiveness.
rules.recommendedAction: Use authentic product imagery or contextual art direction.
rules.exceptions: Abstract visuals may fit deliberate brand.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Track provenance and reuse rights for external assets.
rules.trigger: Image/font/icon/video has no source/licence record.
rules.rationale: Production reuse may violate rights/terms.
rules.recommendedAction: Record original URL, creator, licence, date and restrictions.
rules.exceptions: Original project assets need internal provenance.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Do not communicate status through color alone.
rules.trigger: Status is indicated only by hue.
rules.rationale: Some users may miss the meaning.
rules.recommendedAction: Pair color with text, icon, shape or another cue.
rules.exceptions: Decorative color fields are not statuses.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Ensure keyboard operation and visible focus.
rules.trigger: A control is pointer-only or focus is invisible.
rules.rationale: Keyboard users cannot operate or track interface.
rules.recommendedAction: Use logical order, visible focus and documented patterns.
rules.exceptions: Canvas gestures need accessible alternatives.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Tune density to task frequency and information complexity.
rules.trigger: All dashboards are sparse or dense without role evidence.
rules.rationale: Throughput or comprehension may suffer.
rules.recommendedAction: Test density with realistic data and common tasks.
rules.exceptions: Expert tools may use adjustable compact density.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Preserve approved brand tokens unless redesign is authorized.
rules.trigger: A preset silently replaces project colors or typography.
rules.rationale: Product identity is lost without consent.
rules.recommendedAction: Treat existing tokens as constraints and document migration.
rules.exceptions: Explicit rebrand can replace visual world with approval.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: A reference URL is a research lead, not proof of a verified observation.
rules.trigger: Catalog link is described as inspected without page evidence.
rules.rationale: Decisions gain false confidence.
rules.recommendedAction: Record page, section, date, viewport and observation before verification.
rules.exceptions: Normative source supports only its specific scoped claim.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Treat preset/style matches as provisional candidates.
rules.trigger: A match is applied without checking brand, task or platform.
rules.rationale: Direction may not fit the real product.
rules.recommendedAction: Explain match rationale, alternatives and confidence.
rules.exceptions: Approved preset may apply within scope.

verification.requiredEvidence: Capture actual interface state or source artifact under review.

rules.statement: Separate objective defects, heuristic candidates and subjective preferences.
rules.trigger: Aesthetic preference is reported as a confirmed defect.
rules.rationale: Review quality and trust degrade.
rules.recommendedAction: State evidence, confidence, impact and verification for each finding.
rules.exceptions: Human critique may include opinion when labelled.
